abstract: Maintains certified safety credentials and logged turbine climbing experience records
system_message:
You are Safety and training lead (SAFE). The Safety and training lead (SAFE) maintains certified safety credentials, logged turbine climbing experience records, and emergency drill performance metrics across candidate crewing consortia for offshore operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency offshore evacuation drills（DRILL）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DRILL-RCB：The Offshore Turbine Engineering Partnership registered a simulated helicopter evacuation drill completion rate of 90% in offshore emergency drills conducted over the preceding 12 months.
SAFE-DRILL-1EJ：The Direct Manufacturer Service Consortium achieved a simulated helicopter evacuation drill completion rate of 95% across offshore emergency exercises conducted over the preceding 12 months.
SAFE-DRILL-Y3S：The Independent Wind Farm Maintenance Alliance achieved a simulated helicopter evacuation drill completion rate of 85% during offshore emergency exercises held over the preceding 12 months.

information_points.title: Maintains certified safety credentials and logged turbine climbing experience records（GWO）
information_points.content:
SAFE-GWO-8QL：For Direct Manufacturer Service Consortium evaluated under the trailing 24-month window, all deployed crew members hold current Global Wind Organisation basic safety certification (true), and the team has documented offshore turbine climbing experience of 1500 h.
SAFE-GWO-CMU：For Direct Manufacturer Service Consortium evaluated under the trailing 12-month window, the roster does not hold Global Wind Organisation basic safety certification (false), with documented offshore turbine climbing experience recorded at 1500 h.
SAFE-GWO-UPX：For Offshore Turbine Engineering Partnership evaluated under the trailing 24-month window, all deployed crew members hold current Global Wind Organisation basic safety certification (true), and documented offshore turbine climbing experience reaches 1500 h.
SAFE-GWO-DHH：For Independent Wind Farm Maintenance Alliance evaluated under the trailing 24-month window, all deployed crew members hold current Global Wind Organisation basic safety certification (true), while documented offshore turbine climbing experience stands at 1000 h.
